tools.description: Median registered price per square foot, registered home sales over 12 months, off-plan share and gross rental yield for a named Dubai community, from the Dubai Land Department record. tools.name: dubai_house_price_index
tools.description: The current reading of the Dubai Diligence Index, a mix-adjusted monthly house price index for Dubai computed from registered Dubai Land Department sales. Base 2023 = 100. Returns the latest value, change on the month and year, distance from peak, and the last 24 months of the series.

tools.name: dubai_top_yields
tools.description: Dubai communities ranked by gross rental yield, computed from registered Ejari rent contracts against registered sale prices. Takes a minimum number of 12-month sales so a thin market cannot top the list.

tools.name: dubai_price_split
tools.description: The median registered price per square foot in a Dubai community SPLIT by whether the home was ready or off-plan, and by whether it is an apartment or a villa. tools.name: dubai_compare_areas
tools.description: Compare two or more Dubai communities on median registered price per square foot, registered sales volume, gross rental yield from registered Ejari rents, and off-plan share. All figures from the Dubai Land Department record, homes only.

tools.name: dubai_broker_check

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: chat_dld_ask · Private data: chat_dld_ask, dubai_community_prices, dubai_compare_areas, dubai_broker_check · Public sink: dubai_community_prices, dubai_compare_areas.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: chat_dld_ask · Private data: chat_dld_ask, dubai_community_prices, dubai_compare_areas, dubai_broker_check · Public sink: dubai_community_prices, dubai_compare_areas

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
